question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_________ small businesses shifted within a year.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Many"** means a large number of something. (कई)

 
 
• **Example:** Many students attended the seminar.
 
 
 
• **"Many"** is appropriate for describing a large, indefinite number of small businesses that shifted within a year. (कई)
 
 
• **Example:** Many small businesses shifted within a year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Little** (थोड़ा): A small amount or number.

 
 
• **Example:** Little progress was made in the project.
 
 
 
• **Very** (बहुत): To a high degree.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very talented in music.
 
 
 
• **Quite** (काफी): To the utmost or most absolute extent or degree.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was quite interesting.
